definitions.tasks:
commute.rl_tasks_2191 (module docstring). plural: mined from Pile rows (train rows for training items, val rows from 64 for held-out), the cue a they/their/them token after '<plural det> <noun>s' within 32 tokens with no singular pronoun, a/an, newline or other they/their/them between; target set the six forms of they/their/them that are one token; competitors he/she/it/his/her/its (both forms) and ' a', ' the'. sequence: '<Pile fill>

' + names joined by a separator, ending at the separator; target the next name, competitors the other names of that list in the same form. addition: '<Pile fill>

{a} + {b} =', a + b <= 9; target ' {a+b}', competitors the other nine ' d'
definitions.held-out split: plural: Pile val rows 64-8191 then Pile train rows 32768-49151, disjoint from the training rows 0-32767. sequence: a fifth of each list template (none shared with training, checked in ctl) after val-row fills. addition: val-row fills only; the 55 facts are shared (a fact held out could not be taught)
definitions.controls (cue removed): plural: the antecedent made singular in the same window (these -> this, those -> that, other determiners -> the; the noun without its s, one token by construction), target set unchanged. sequence: the shown names in a seeded shuffle that is not the original order and does not end on its last name; the read token is the original next name. addition: '{a}, {b} =' (no operator), the read token the sum
definitions.reward: the sampled token (temperature 1, one token at the cue) is in the item's target set
definitions.held-out read: deterministic, on the first 512 held-out items: top-1 (argmax in the target set), top-5, contrast (below) and the control's top-1 (argmax equal to a token of its read set); standard errors over items (sd / sqrt(n)). At step 0, step 10 and the stop (the saved bf16 state)
definitions.contrast: logsumexp of the logits over the target set minus over the competitor set at the cue = log p(target set) - log p(competitor set) (rl_tasks_2191.set_contrast); the readers' unit (SetRead, 'contrast')
definitions.collapsed: at least half of the KL rows' positions (64 x 512) share one argmax token
definitions.learned: RL seed 0 (jobs `arm 1 rl 0`, `arm 2 rl 0`) reached the size target, its held-out top-1 at the stop is more than 2 se of the difference above step 0's (strictly), and its control top-1 rose by at most 2 se of the difference (inclusive), on both tasks. Read by every own, demo, shuffled and anchor-demo job before it trains
definitions.stable null: E220's: the shuffled arm reaches the size target within 600 steps, its held-out top-1 at the stop within 2 se of the difference of step 0's (inclusive), not collapsed, on both tasks at one rate; the lowest stable rate is used; none stops the cell
definitions.size, kl: E220's: size on the live fp32 weights after every step (the stop), size_saved on the bf16 state; kl a reading every 5 steps and kl_saved on the saved state
definitions.readings: E222's (E211's Reader) on the set contrast: gain T1 - T0, share (L01 - L00) / gain on the released decomposition, untrained svd and rotated, neuron k64 and k matched, pooled steering; no k_half (one target token per row is what it reads). Read rows the first 256 held-out items, fitting windows the first 600 training items

control.ctl (training run), first and alone: item counts per task (held-out at least 1,000 each or stop; no held-out sequence template in training or stop); W0's held-out reads; a zero update reads stage 1's KL exactly 0.0 and the same 64 x 8 sampled tokens (or stop); 5 RL steps timed per task (W0 restored after, asserted by the next job's step 0); E211's ctl unchanged: E53's lowercase and cipher seed-0 states re-read to their saved numbers within E211's tolerances (or stop)
control.read ctl (reading run), first and alone: a zero update on each task's read rows reads every numerator exactly 0 (or exit 1)
control.do-nothing, first in each reading job: a Gaussian update at the task's first state's per-matrix norms: contrast gain under MIN_GAIN (1) or exit 1
control.input check: every state's sha256 equals its training record's

task2191 top-1 / top-5.source: the user's task#2191 PDF (Pile-4L, 30 items each), recorded beside ctl's W0 reads

expected.item counts: measured by the CPU dry run (2026-11-20, same code and rows): plural 2,892 training items from all 32,768 train rows (0.088 per row; under n_train, so plural trains on 2,892) and 689 held-out from the 8,128 val rows, so with the extra rows 1,024 held-out after about 4,000 of them (expected; ctl writes it); 1,540 distinct noun -> pronoun pairs in training, 532 in the val held-out, 305 shared. sequence: 4,096 / 1,024, 726 / 183 distinct templates of 728 / 184, none shared. addition: 4,096 / 1,024, all 55 facts in both

W0 held-out (n 512 in the training reads.why: our items differ from the PDF's 30 (Pile fills, several list forms, mined contexts), so bands not points; addition's contrast near log(1/9) = -2.2 if the model spreads its digit mass evenly

expected.zero update: kl exactly 0.0; same sampled tokens true
expected.ctl e53: E222's ctl values (predictions_E222.json expected.ctl e53/*): lowercase share 0.7538, cipher 0.1249, every other number within E211's tolerances
expected.seconds per RL step: 0.1 to 0.5 on an L40 (one sampled token per sequence: one forward of 128 x 64 to sample, one forward-backward of 128 x 65; E220's 16-token step took ~4 s)
expected.steps to the target: about E220's: RL 20-45, own 20-35, demo 18-30, shuffled at 3e-5 25-40, at 1e-5 ~300, at 1e-4 ~3 (size ~0.008), at 3e-4 1 (size ~0.014). Anchor RL seed 0: rewards nearly always 0, so the gradient is near 0 on most groups: 40 steps to never (600 steps, not reached)
expected.RL seed 0 at the target: plural top-1 +0.1 to +0.4, sequence +0.1 to +0.5, both over 2 se (~0.06): learned passes on top-1 (probability 0.8). Control top-1 rise: plural 0 to +0.15 (a general 'they' push would show here), sequence -0.05 to +0.05. Control gate passes on both (probability 0.6); the learned gate as a whole (probability 0.5)
expected.null at 3e-5: stable on both tasks (probability 0.6), as E220 found on repeat and lower
expected.own and demo at the target: held-out top-1 up +0.05 to +0.3 (they train on the exact cue token, unlike E220's 16-token samples)
expected.anchor: demo: top-1 from ~0.05 to 0.2-0.8 (55 facts, about 800 demonstrations seen); rl seed 0: under +0.1

reads (run 7).Gaussian: contrast gain within +-0.1 of 0 (E222's Gaussians read 0.002-0.02 in lo)
reads (run 7).prior (W0 mean contrast on the read rows: plural -0.5 to 2; sequence -1 to 2.5; addition -3.5 to -1
reads (run 7).gain and readability (floor 1 in the con: RL 0.5 to 2.5 on both picks (readable, probability 0.6 each); own and demo 0.3 to 2 (readable, probability 0.5); shuffled -0.3 to 0.3 (unreadable); anchor demo 2 to 5 (readable)
reads (run 7).share on a readable state: 0.1 to 0.8 (E53's cipher and lowercase range); no point value
reads (run 7).seconds per state: about 23 s on an L40 (E222: 18 s at 200 rows of 65; these are 256 of 64)

rules.floor: MIN_GAIN = 1 in the set contrast (commute.local_faith), applied by the reader
rules.per pick, on the share: E222's rule unchanged (score_stage3.pick_call, card_call), with the picks plural and sequence and the anchor addition's three demo seeds: no call when fewer than two arms are readable or RL or demo is not; rival a when every pair of rl, own, demo is alike and each is above the anchor and above shuffled where readable; rival b when demo is apart from rl and own (if readable) is alike rl; else neither. Third outcome beside: shuffled readable and alike rl
rules.card: E222's: the same call on every pick that has one; split when they differ; no call when neither has one
rules.beside, not filed: the same rule on untrained (svd, rotated), steering, neuron (k64, k matched); the anchor's RL seed 0 values; each state's training reads

edge_cases.checked: 2026-11-20 by reading the code (run_newtasks.learned, job_null, null_lr; rl_tasks_2191.member, set_contrast, reads; score_stage3's rule, whose edge cases E222 ran) and, for the generators, reward and contrast, the CPU dry run named in the plan section
edge_cases.padding: target and competitor sets are padded with -1; member never matches -1 (token ids are non-negative), set_contrast masks -1 to -inf before the logsumexp; a set of one token gives that token's logit
edge_cases.empty competitor or target set: cannot arise: every task's sets have 1+ targets and 6+ competitors (asserted shapes); target and competitor sets never meet (asserted in Items)
edge_cases.learned: gain exactly 2 se: fails (strictly more); control rise exactly 2 se passes (inclusive)
edge_cases.se of 0: top-1 at 0 or 1 on every item gives se 0: learned then passes only on a gain above 0, the control only with no rise; the null is stable only if top-1 did not move
edge_cases.anchor RL never reaches the target: saved and read as not reached (an extra reading, no gate reads it)
edge_cases.sequence control with 2 names: the reversed pair (the only order that is not the original), which never ends on the original last name
edge_cases.pool under 256: the arm is skipped and recorded
edge_cases.do-nothing state: a Gaussian or zero update reads every ratio nan (gain under the floor), so it cannot pass either rival's bar

prediction.card: no call (probability 0.4): an arm under the floor on a pick. Given a call: rival a 0.5, rival b 0.3, neither 0.2
prediction.third outcome: not read (shuffled under the floor, probability 0.85)
prediction.anchor: readable on all three demo seeds, share 0.1 to 0.8
